data.explanation: This is a craftsman's final invoice for gutter and downpipe work that has been completed. You need to transfer €1,249.50 to the company's account, stating the invoice number as the payment reference, within 30 days of the invoice date shown above. If you don't pay by then, the company could send reminders or charge late-payment interest, though none is mentioned here. Keep this invoice: craftsman labor costs (Handwerkerleistungen) for work on your home can often be deducted from German income tax, so consider mentioning it when you file your tax return.

data.tax_note: Craftsman invoices for work carried out on your home, such as this gutter and downpipe renewal, can often be claimed under §35a EStG (Handwerkerleistungen) to reduce your income tax; keep this invoice together with proof of the bank transfer for your tax return.
